honestStubs.what: the ghost in M1a (the lead's city preview)
honestStubs.state: The ghost can be PICKED in the legacy select screen (SE-G5: a fourth button, Bu / Hviske in the dropdown) and WALKED around with its own baked sprite (hover, idle, glide walk and run) because the built stub player draws any skin. It has NO perks, NO bob, NO glow and NO hat / shirt layers there: those need P06 (Player2D), G-ghost-play and the wardrobe packages (M1b). The four-card page, the hero chips and the Danish hero blurbs arrive with P16 (M1b).

The ghost only LOOKS floaty: collisions are the figure ellipse of every race, ponds block the ghost like everybody (the fairy's flight is the only crossing perk). The whisper GHOST_WHISPER_WATER exists as a key but is a stub, cut first.
No footstep sound exists for ANY race in the plan; the name sfx/ghost_whoosh is only reserved (silent without a file).

The stock-rig glide: 5 px bob, leaning, paddling mittens, a swaying wisp. A dedicated hover / glide clip set (the fairy's four flight clips) would add 4 clips x 2 heroes and 4 more layer groups per garment and was not built.
Built, baked, imported and compared at zoom 0.4 / 0.9: invisible at game scale; REJECTED. S3TC (DXT5) handled the alpha ramp without artefacts (fix_alpha_border true), so the door stays open.
The player has no voice; the nine reaction lines are text-only until P24 voices them in wave 6.
None. The player is the only ghost; the hero-twin rule needs no change.

honestStubs.what: pants and shoes of a ghost
honestStubs.state: Worn, counted in perks, set bonuses and the RarityAura, never drawn (29 of 96 wearables are pants or shoes, 6 of 21 unique / legendary pieces, among them the capstone pants_trousers_starlight and the legendary shoes_boots_wind). The cue of a legendary piece is the gold aura, the Garderobe tag and the equip toast, not a layer; item flavour text such as "De glimter, når du går" stays. A tint-ready hem layer in the colour of the worn piece (every item has art.palette: +1 bake, +0.5 CPU-min, +0.7 MB) is the known upgrade if play shows the invisible cue disappoints; not built.

honestStubs.what: ghost glow in the farm at dusk
honestStubs.state: A PointLight2D that lights the grass around the ghost at dusk and night; at noon it is invisible by the night factor. It is the ghost's second player light in the forest (lantern + glow = 2).
The thorn-berry-pink flash tints a pink-lilac sprite: less contrast than on the others; the heart bar, the knock-back and the hit clip carry the feedback.
